title: Pure Constellar
summary: Unified Constellar and tellarknight Xyz build from the Glorious Gallery support wave, combining Constellar Castor, Tellarknight Cygnian, and Stellarnova Bonds with generic staples and a Rank 4 toolbox. The modern support treats Constellar and tellarknight as a single engine that climbs from Rank 4 to Rank 5, 6, and 7 Xyz bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Constellar Castor is a one-card starter: when Normal or Special Summoned, it Special Summons a Constellar monster with a different name from the Deck, and grants a Spell negate to a LIGHT Xyz Summoned using it.

Tellarknight Cygnian (always treated as a Constellar card) searches any tellarknight or Constellar monster on summon, raises two monsters' Levels by 1, and can be treated as 2 materials for a 3-material Xyz.
Stellarnova Bonds discards 1 card to Special Summon a tellarknight or Constellar of a different Type from the Deck, and Reinforcement of the Army searches Cygnian, Lyran, Deneb, or Pollux.

summary.title: Opening: Constellar Castor
steps: Normal Summon Constellar Castor and use its effect to Special Summon Tellarknight Cygnian from the Deck; Cygnian searches Tellarknight Lyran or Constellar Caduceus.
Special Summon Lyran (on a Normal Summon) or Caduceus (while controlling a Constellar) to search Constellar Tellarknights or Constellar Star Chart.

Overlay into Tellarknight Constellar Delteros to search another monster and gain an extra LIGHT Normal Summon, or make Tellarknight Constellar Caduceus to recover cards from the GY and copy a Normal Summon effect from the Deck.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Tellarknight Ptolemaeus detaches 3 materials as a Quick Effect on either turn to Rank-Up into Constellar Pleiades (which bounces any card on either turn) or Stellarknight Constellar Diamond (which blocks Deck-to-GY sends, banishes returning GY cards, and negates DARK monster effects).

Constellar Ptolemy M7 overlays onto any Constellar Xyz to bounce a monster from either field or GY to the hand, and Exstellarknight Constellar Ptolemy Ω7 overlays onto a Constellar Xyz in Main Phase 2 to shuffle opposing monsters into the Deck.
Stellarknight Delteros makes your summons unrespondable and pops cards, while Constellar Omega makes all your Constellars unaffected by Spells/Traps as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Spells & Restrictions
points: Constellar Tellarknights revives a tellarknight or Constellar from the hand or GY on activation and lets you Xyz Summon a different-Rank tellarknight or Constellar Xyz on top of one you control.
Stellarnova Bonds also negates the effects of face-up monsters the opponent controls up to the number of LIGHT and DARK Xyz Monsters you control.
Constellar Castor locks your Extra Deck summons to LIGHT and DARK monsters for the rest of the turn, and Stellarnova Bonds locks you into Xyz Monsters from the Extra Deck for the turn.
